lines.zh: 我摆尾游水，背鳍破开水面。
lines.en: I swim with a sweep of my tail, my dorsal fin cutting the surface.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里穿行，影子贴着底。
lines.en: I thread the shallows, my shadow hugging the bottom.

lines.zh: 我身体一扭一扭，软骨很灵活。
lines.en: My body twists and turns; cartilage is flexible.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑，腹鳍轻轻扫过。
lines.en: I skim the sandbed, my fins brushing it.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁石边缘游，找缝隙。
lines.en: I swim the reef's edge, looking for gaps.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，水纹一圈圈散开。
lines.en: I sweep my tail; ripples spread outward.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺划过水草。
lines.en: The spines on my back rake the weeds.

lines.zh: 我游到深处，水变得很凉。
lines.en: I descend to where the water is cold.
I bank and change course.

lines.zh: 我从岩洞这头游到那头。
lines.en: I swim from one end of the cave to the other.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，躲进水草。
lines.en: I sink low and hide in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我一路游，嘴里不断开合。
lines.en: I swim on, my mouth working.

lines.zh: 我贴近石壁，蹭掉了背上的藻。
lines.en: I rub against the wall and shed the algae.
I swim slowly, like a patrol.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一摆，荡起一团沙。
lines.en: One flick of my tail stirs up a cloud of sand.
I roll over just beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流漂了一小段。
lines.en: I drift with the current a short way.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一块石头游了三圈。
lines.en: I circle the same rock three times.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，背鳍微微晃。
lines.en: I hang in the water; my dorsal fin sways.

lines.zh: 我让水从鳃缝里慢慢过去。
lines.en: I let the water drift slowly through my gills.

lines.zh: 我盯着沙面上一处凹坑。
lines.en: I stare at a dip in the sand.
My spines catch the light underwater.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有鳍在动。
lines.en: I hold still; only my fins move.
I sink slowly, then rise.
I turn my head toward a rock.
A small string of bubbles leaves my mouth.

lines.zh: 我保持着这个角度，很省力。
lines.en: I hold this angle. It costs nothing.

lines.zh: 水底的碎石硌着我的腹。
lines.en: Gravel on the riverbed presses my belly.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑纹跟着光变。
lines.en: The pattern on me shifts with the light.

lines.zh: 我尾巴轻轻摆一下就停。
lines.en: My tail moves once, then stops.
I ease back into the weeds.
I wait for something to swim near.
I raise my head and look at you from below.
Your shadow wavers above. I keep watching.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游向你脚下的浅滩。
lines.en: I swim slowly toward the shallows by your feet.

lines.zh: 我绕着你浸在水里的腿游。
lines.en: I circle the legs you have in the water.

lines.zh: 你把脚挪开，我跟了一步。
lines.en: You move your feet; I follow a little.
I mean you no harm.

lines.zh: 我游得更近，鳍几乎碰到你。
lines.en: I come closer until my fin nearly touches you.

lines.zh: 我抬头，水面把光晃在你脸上。
lines.en: I look up; the surface throws light on your face.
I circle your ankles in the shallows.
I draw back a little, waiting for your hand.

lines.zh: 我甩尾挣开，游远了一点。
lines.en: I lash my tail, break free, and swim off a little.
My fins are askew; I swim unevenly.
I sink to the bottom and hold.

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺断了一根。
lines.en: One of the spines on my back has snapped.
I hide around a rock.
I release a hurried string of bubbles.
I press to the sand and stay low.
I swim slower than before.
I retreat into the weeds.
I rise again and test myself.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我立刻游过去。
lines.en: Something sinks; I swim to it at once.
I circle it on the bottom.
I open my mouth and draw it in.

lines.zh: 我又吐出来，嚼了两下再吞。
lines.en: I spit it out, chew twice, and swallow.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我游一趟。
lines.en: This is not worth the swim.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度引我过来。
lines.en: The warmth of your palm draws me over.
I look up, waiting for more.

lines.zh: 我把沙子也一起吸进去了。
lines.en: I take in sand along with it.

lines.zh: 我闻着血腥味又游回来。
lines.en: The smell of blood brings me circling back.

lines.zh: 我停在你手下面，不动了。
lines.en: I stop beneath your hand and hold.
You touch me; I dart away.
I am pushed into a half roll.
My spines brush your hand.
My fins sweep up a layer of fine sand.
I press past you.
My dorsal fin wedges into a rock crevice.
I do not struggle hard.

lines.zh: 我尾巴甩了一下，水花溅起。
lines.en: My tail flicks and throws up spray.

lines.zh: 我又游回来，靠近你的手。
lines.en: I swim back toward your hand.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，只有水声。
lines.en: We collide; there is only water sound.
Another swims out from behind the reef.

lines.zh: 我们并肩游，尾巴一前一后。
lines.en: We swim abreast, tails falling into rhythm.
I sway my dorsal fin toward my mate.

lines.zh: 它用鳍碰了碰我的侧腹。
lines.en: It touches my flank with a fin.
We sink to the bottom together.
Its dorsal fin is narrower than mine.
We settle side by side on the sand.
The current pushes us together.
It leaves first; I follow.
We part among the weeds.
I draw it in with one pull.
I spit it out to look.
I try to swallow it whole.
My teeth skid across it.
I carry it in my mouth down to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我扇动胸鳍，把它盖上沙。
lines.en: I fan my pectoral fins to bury it in sand.
I drop it and swim off.
I take a bite, and my teeth feel dull.
It sinks. I do not follow.
I nudge the pebble aside with my snout.
You have stepped into the water.
I turn to face you.
I sink slowly to your feet.

lines.zh: 我把铁砧似的背鳍立起。
lines.en: I raise my anvil-shaped dorsal fin.
This stretch of bottom is mine.
I begin to circle.
I stir the water.
You back onto the bank; I stop.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，水纹告诉我。
lines.en: You stepped into the water. The ripples tell me.
I swim toward your ankle.
I circle your feet, again and again.
You shift feet; I shift with you.

lines.zh: 我背鳍上的棘刺竖了起来。
lines.en: The spines on my dorsal fin have risen.
You should not stand in the water.

lines.zh: 我一次次擦过你的小腿。
lines.en: I keep brushing your calf.
My spines stay raised.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍在水底划过去。
lines.en: My dorsal fin cuts across the riverbed.

lines.zh: 水纹把我的位置说出来了。
lines.en: The ripples give me away.
I stop at your feet and hold.
I rise until my dorsal fin breaks the surface.
I bite your ankle.
I strike your leg with my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我的棘刺划开一道口子。
lines.en: My spines open a cut.
I wrap your foot and pull down.
The bite does not hold.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，水花打在你脸上。
lines.en: I lash my tail; spray hits your face.
I sweep past your legs.
I retreat deep, then rise again.
I scrape your skin with rows of fine teeth.
I wheel around and ram again.
I appear out of the water.

lines.zh: 我先摆了一下尾，确认能游。
lines.en: I sweep my tail once to check it works.

lines.zh: 这里的水比我记得的浅。
lines.en: The water is shallower than I remember.
I settle against the sandbed.
The spines on my back rise.
I swim toward the light.
At first I am only a small shadow.
I circle myself half a turn.

lines.zh: 我绕着新落下的石子游。
lines.en: I circle the freshly fallen stones.
I slip from the weeds into deeper water.

lines.zh: 我成了水草间一小片影。
lines.en: I become a small shadow among the weeds.
I begin patrolling along the bank.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我拼命游开。
lines.en: The water heats; I swim away hard.

lines.zh: 我摔在水面上，砸出一片浪。
lines.en: I hit the surface and throw up a wave.

lines.zh: 水本该是我的地方，可它压住了我。
lines.en: The water should be mine, yet it presses me down.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水和沙一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast throws water and sand together.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过水面，扎进我身体。
lines.en: An arrow crosses the water and buries in me.

lines.zh: 那股光在水里烧得发白。
lines.en: That light burns white in the water.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我游不动了。
lines.en: Too long unfed; I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 雷透过水打进来，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning comes through the water; I go numb.
The water is gone; I thrash in the air.
